specialist_roles.purpose: Inspect code, architecture, canonical documents, and primary sources without changing the subject under review.
specialist_roles.stop_condition: Return findings and evidence references when the bounded question is answered or blocked.

specialist_roles.purpose: Implement one approved vertical slice or bounded candidate repair.
specialist_roles.stop_condition: Stop after the owned slice and its focused checks are complete, blocked, or outside scope.

specialist_roles.purpose: Independently review product, engineering, code, security, or run evidence without changing the reviewed subject.
specialist_roles.stop_condition: Return prioritized findings, disposition, and evidence; do not fix or advance the graph.

specialist_roles.purpose: Exercise runnable behavior, browser flows, and deterministic checks against a frozen candidate.
specialist_roles.stop_condition: Return reproducible results and evidence when the assigned checks finish, block, or reveal a candidate defect.

predicate_definitions.run_classified: True only when one coherent requested outcome has a mission anchor, lane, tier, completion target, selected and skipped stages with reasons, and a valid authority envelope.
predicate_definitions.annotation_problem_ledger_recorded: True only when every source annotation is preserved, compound comments are atomized, every observation maps to exactly one underlying problem or explicit non-actionable disposition, counts reconcile, every actionable problem states the desired outcome and proof or has an unanswered material clarification, and no value is guessed.
predicate_definitions.annotation_task_bridge_recorded: True only when every accepted problem has exactly one idempotent creation-or-reuse receipt for the canonical general task list, the ledger stores the same task reference and status, and task-write authority is current.
predicate_definitions.next_annotation_problem_selected: True only when the ledger selects exactly one dependency-ready problem for a child run or records that no ready problem remains and classifies the aggregate terminal status with failed taking precedence over blocked and blocked over completed.
predicate_definitions.annotation_problem_run_recorded: True only when one child SOP SLOP run receipt is bound to the selected problem and source annotations, reaches a terminal status with current evidence, passes controller validation, and both the parent ledger and canonical durable task record the same status without ticking off unsupported work.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_selected: True only when route_card.entry_stage names exactly one known node or marks routing as requiring a human decision.
predicate_definitions.human_decision_recorded: True only when every decision-receipt field is present and selection is non-empty and matches an offered choice or explicit free-form answer.
predicate_definitions.alignment_locked: True only when the current alignment artifact is recorded and a receipt binds the accepted outcome, behavior, scope, non-goals, and authority boundaries to that exact subject revision.
predicate_definitions.current_artifact_recorded: True only when the artifact receipt resolves and its digest equals the current subject revision required by the node.
predicate_definitions.verification_recorded: True only when a non-stale verification receipt records pass, fail, or blocked for the exact subject digest.
predicate_definitions.review_disposition_recorded: True only when a non-stale gating-review receipt records exactly one of accepted, revision_required, or fatal for the exact subject digest.
predicate_definitions.strategy_decision_recorded: True only when the settled strategy decision is present in the workspace's canonical artifact and its receipt matches that artifact digest.
predicate_definitions.next_slice_selected: True only when the selector records exactly one incomplete approved slice or records that no approved slices remain.
predicate_definitions.slice_delivery_recorded: True only when one receipt binds the approved slice ID and plan digest to its delivered commit and focused verification references; later unrelated repository movement does not stale it.
predicate_definitions.candidate_repair_recorded: True only when the repaired candidate artifact and focused verification receipt reference the same exact repaired candidate revision.
predicate_definitions.candidate_assembled: True only when the candidate manifest names one frozen revision, includes every approved slice receipt for the current plan digest, and each delivered commit is represented in the candidate history.
predicate_definitions.fork_manifest_recorded: True only when the fork manifest binds all dispatched branches and their isolation mode to one frozen subject digest.
predicate_definitions.all_dispatched_evidence_current: True only when every branch named by the fork manifest returned non-stale evidence for the same subject digest.
predicate_definitions.candidate_resolution_recorded: True only when the joined evidence is classified as accepted, revision_required, or fatal and the result is recorded for that candidate digest.
predicate_definitions.release_preflight_recorded: True only when release readiness, repository state, the requested release level, and the complete authority required by each compound release executor are recorded for the exact candidate revision.
predicate_definitions.compound_release_recorded: True only when the compound executor records every attempted external action, final result, verification result, authority used, and exact subject revision.
predicate_definitions.release_target_classified: True only when a successful ship receipt is current and the route card selects exactly one next outcome: stop at the change request or invoke land-and-deploy.
predicate_definitions.run_receipt_recorded: True only when an immutable receipt records graph version, status, decisions, transitions, evidence references, authority use, and timestamps.
predicate_definitions.run_review_recorded: True when either a normal ordered-objective review is complete or a degraded receipt records review_error, policy_issue, no proposal, and preserves delivery_status as effective_status; a confirmed hard-invariant breach preserves the delivery receipt and sets effective_status to failed.
predicate_definitions.run_closed: True only when the terminal status matches the reviewed run receipt and the run review receipt is retained.
predicate_definitions.stage_completed: True only when the current node's declared completion predicate is true using current, non-stale required evidence.
predicate_definitions.annotation_batch_present: True only when the request explicitly supplies an annotation batch or contains multiple annotations whose shared parent mission is review and resolution.
predicate_definitions.annotation_batch_absent: True only when annotation_batch_present is false for evidenced ordinary intake.
predicate_definitions.annotation_problems_identified: True only when the ledger has at least one accepted underlying problem, complete observation coverage, a recorded clarification state for every problem, and a dependency order; independent clear problems may be ready while other problems still need clarification.
predicate_definitions.annotation_batch_has_no_actionable_probl: True only when every annotation has a reconciled non-actionable disposition and the ledger contains zero accepted problems.
predicate_definitions.annotation_batch_intake_blocked: True only when material intent or required source evidence cannot be obtained within the clarification budget and the ledger records the exact affected problems, owner, and smallest unblocker.
predicate_definitions.annotation_tasks_recorded: True only when annotation_task_bridge_recorded is true for every accepted problem and no supporting duplicate created another durable task.
predicate_definitions.annotation_task_bridge_blocked: True only when an accepted problem lacks a canonical task because the general task list, idempotent adapter, or bounded write authority is unavailable, and the exact missing prerequisite is recorded.
predicate_definitions.ready_annotation_problem_exists: True only when at least one accepted problem is ready, not already terminal, and all of its dependencies have validated completed receipts; exactly one next problem is selected.
predicate_definitions.annotation_problem_clarification_recorde: True only when one highest-dependency material question has a non-empty decision receipt, the affected problem record is updated without changing unrelated problems, and its canonical task status is synchronized from blocked to ready or remains blocked with an exact reason.
predicate_definitions.annotation_clarification_required: True only when no dependency-safe ready problem has precedence and at least one accepted problem has a material user-intent gap that can be resolved by one focused question.
predicate_definitions.all_annotation_problems_completed: True only when annotation coverage is complete and every accepted problem has a controller-validated completed child receipt at its requested completion target.
predicate_definitions.annotation_batch_has_blocked_problem: True only when no ready problem remains, no accepted problem has failed, and at least one accepted problem is blocked with an exact gate and unblocker.
predicate_definitions.annotation_batch_has_failed_problem: True only when no ready problem remains and at least one accepted problem has a controller-validated failed child receipt; failed takes precedence over blocked aggregate status.
predicate_definitions.external_action_succeeded: True only when the current compound external-action receipt records success for every required action against the exact authorized resource, environment, and revision.
predicate_definitions.external_action_blocked: True only when the current compound external-action receipt records blocked, identifies one unresolved gate, and records no unauthorized action.
predicate_definitions.external_action_failed: True only when the current compound external-action receipt records a non-recoverable failure after preserving the attempted actions and evidence.
predicate_definitions.decision_recorded: True only when the pending material decision satisfies human_decision_recorded and its scope matches the waiting run.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_requires_decision: True only when current evidence cannot select exactly one entry stage because a material routing fact is unresolved.
predicate_definitions.review_accepted: True only when the current gating-review receipt disposition equals accepted for the exact current subject digest.
predicate_definitions.review_revision_required: True only when the current gating-review receipt disposition equals revision_required, identifies the owning artifact and root cause, and its revision budget remains.
predicate_definitions.review_fatal: True only when the current gating-review receipt disposition equals fatal or revision_required cannot continue because its bounded revision budget is exhausted.
predicate_definitions.strategy_opportunity_review_required: True only when the strategy decision concerns a customer problem, demand, wedge, or product opportunity and no current opportunity review exists.
predicate_definitions.strategy_opportunity_review_not_required: True only when strategy_opportunity_review_required is false for an evidenced non-opportunity strategy decision.
predicate_definitions.strategy_creates_product_change: True only when the canonical strategy decision explicitly requires a change to product behavior or product-domain truth.
predicate_definitions.strategy_run_complete: True only when the strategy decision is the requested completion target and strategy_creates_product_change is false.
predicate_definitions.product_opportunity_review_required: True only when problem, demand, wedge, or solution premise remains disputed and no current opportunity review resolves it.
predicate_definitions.product_opportunity_review_not_required: True only when product_opportunity_review_required is false and a skip reason cites current canonical evidence.
predicate_definitions.product_review_finishes_run: True only when the product review disposition is accepted and this is review-only work or the requested completion target is the reviewed product direction.
predicate_definitions.product_spec_required: True only when the product review disposition is accepted, the run continues as a product change, and no current canonical specification captures the settled decisions.
predicate_definitions.spec_finishes_run: True only when the requested completion target is the canonical specification and no selected downstream review remains.
predicate_definitions.experience_review_required: True only when a person sees or interacts with the change and no current design-review receipt covers the specification digest.
predicate_definitions.engineering_review_required_next: True only when experience_review_required is false and a T2 or T3 build still lacks engineering-review evidence for the specification digest.
predicate_definitions.experience_review_finishes_run: True only when the experience-review disposition is accepted and this is design-review-only work or the requested completion target is the reviewed interaction contract.
predicate_definitions.engineering_review_follows: True only when the experience-review disposition is accepted, the run continues beyond experience review, and engineering-review evidence is missing or stale.
predicate_definitions.engineering_review_finishes_run: True only when the engineering-review disposition is accepted and this is engineering-review-only work or the requested completion target is the reviewed implementation plan.
predicate_definitions.slicing_required: True only when the engineering-review disposition is accepted, the run requests implementation, and the reviewed specification contains at least one undelivered vertical slice.
predicate_definitions.unfinished_slice_exists: True only when exactly one next approved slice can be selected after excluding slices with a valid receipt for that slice ID and current plan digest, plus explicitly blocked slices.
predicate_definitions.all_slices_complete: True only when every approved slice has a valid receipt bound to its slice ID, current plan digest, and delivered commit, and unfinished_slice_exists is false.
predicate_definitions.candidate_revision_required: True only when joined candidate evidence contains a recoverable failure and the candidate-revision budget is not exhausted.
predicate_definitions.candidate_reaches_requested_level: True only when candidate evidence is accepted and the requested completion target is candidate or earlier.
predicate_definitions.candidate_release_requested: True only when candidate evidence is accepted and the requested completion target requires PR, merge, staging, or production evidence.
predicate_definitions.candidate_fatal: True only when joined evidence contains a non-recoverable failure or the applicable revision budget is exhausted.
predicate_definitions.release_authority_needed: True only when preflight otherwise permits release but the authority envelope omits any action the selected compound executors may perform: commit, push, and change-request creation for ship; plus merge, deploy, verify, and recovery for land-and-deploy.
predicate_definitions.release_execution_authorized: True only when preflight passes and the authority envelope covers every action, resource, environment, limit, expiry, and recovery boundary that all selected compound release executors may use.
predicate_definitions.release_preflight_failed: True only when preflight records a non-authority failure that prevents safe invocation of a compound release executor.
predicate_definitions.authority_granted: True only when a non-empty human decision explicitly adds the complete compound action set, resources, environments, limits, recovery boundary, and expiry required by the requested release level.
predicate_definitions.authority_denied: True only when the human explicitly refuses the requested authority; unanswered is neither granted nor denied.
predicate_definitions.ship_reaches_requested_level: True only when ship succeeded and the requested completion level is the verified change request produced by ship.
predicate_definitions.ship_requires_land_and_deploy: True only when ship succeeded, its exact remote revision is current, and the requested completion level requires merge and deployment.
predicate_definitions.run_status_completed: True only when run_review_receipt.effective_status equals completed and delivery_status was not upgraded from a less safe status.
predicate_definitions.run_status_blocked: True only when run_review_receipt.effective_status equals blocked and its exact unresolved gate and proposed unblocker are recorded.
predicate_definitions.run_status_failed: True only when run_review_receipt.effective_status equals failed and preserved evidence identifies either the delivery failure or a confirmed post-run hard-invariant breach.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_align_strategy: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals align_strategy.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_validate_strategy_opportu: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals validate_strategy_opportunity.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_record_strategy_decision: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals record_strategy_decision.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_map_program: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals map_program.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_align_product: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals align_product.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_validate_product_opportun: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals validate_product_opportunity.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_review_product_direction: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals review_product_direction.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_specify_product: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals specify_product.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_review_experience: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals review_experience.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_review_engineering: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals review_engineering.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_plan_slices: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals plan_slices.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_select_next_slice: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals select_next_slice.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_assemble_candidate: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals assemble_candidate.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_candidate_verification_fo: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals candidate_verification_fork.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_prepare_release: True only when routing is unambiguous and route_card.entry_stage equals prepare_release.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_ship_change: True only when routing is unambiguous, full ship authority and preflight evidence are current, and route_card.entry_stage equals ship_change.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_resolve_ship_success: True only when routing is unambiguous, a current successful ship receipt exists, and route_card.entry_stage equals resolve_ship_success.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_land_and_deploy_change: True only when routing is unambiguous, full land-and-deploy authority and successful ship evidence are current, and route_card.entry_stage equals land_and_deploy_change.
predicate_definitions.entry_stage_is_record_run_receipt: True only when routing is unambiguous, the requested completion level is already evidenced, and route_card.entry_stage equals record_run_receipt.

dynamic_node_templates.outcome: Suspend one named pre-build host, record one material choice, then resume that same host.

nodes.outcome: Classify one coherent outcome, bind its mission anchor, and bind its authority envelope.

Preserve and atomize every annotation, cluster observations by underlying problem and desired outcome, quantify the batch, record each problem's clarification state, and produce a dependency-ordered problem ledger.
Reuse or create exactly one idempotent durable task per accepted underlying problem in the canonical general task list and bind every task reference to the ledger.
Select exactly one dependency-ready problem, or classify the parent batch as completed, blocked, or failed when no ready problem remains.
Inspect first, ask one highest-dependency material intent question for exactly one problem, and update only that problem and its canonical task.
Run one selected problem through the smallest valid child SOP SLOP route to its requested completion target, validate the child receipt, and synchronize only that problem and its durable task.
Select the earliest incomplete stage without rerunning evidenced work.
Record the material choice needed to make routing deterministic.
Resolve the strategy decision tree one material choice at a time and record the alignment lock.
Challenge customer problem, demand, wedge, or product opportunity assumptions and record an accepted, revision-required, or fatal disposition.
Record the settled decision in the workspace's canonical artifact.
Map a T3 program into bounded workflow runs with a clear frontier.
Resolve product language, behavior, boundaries, and hard decisions, then record the alignment lock.
Validate the product premise, demand, wedge, or customer problem and record an accepted, revision-required, or fatal disposition.
Review product value, economics, scope, security, rollout, and long-term cost and record an accepted, revision-required, or fatal disposition.
Synthesize settled intent into the canonical product specification and test seams.
Review user-visible states, decisions, accessibility, and interaction flow and record an accepted, revision-required, or fatal disposition.
Review architecture, data flow, failure modes, security, tests, and rollout and record an accepted, revision-required, or fatal disposition.
Record the minimum vertical slices in the canonical task source of truth.
Select the next incomplete approved vertical slice or declare all slices complete using receipts bound to slice ID and plan digest.
Implement and verify one approved vertical slice, then bind its receipt to slice ID, approved plan digest, and delivered commit.
Freeze one combined candidate revision, prove every delivered commit is represented, and build its evidence manifest.
Dispatch independent review, runtime exercise, and required checks against one frozen candidate.
Perform an independent production-risk review of the frozen candidate.
Exercise the user or service flow against the frozen candidate.
Run the repository's required deterministic checks against the frozen candidate.
Join all dispatched evidence for the exact candidate revision.
Resolve the candidate as accepted, revision-required, or fatal without hiding failed evidence.
Repair the evidenced candidate root cause within the approved revision budget without rewriting historical slice receipts.
Verify candidate readiness and require the full authority envelope for every action the selected compound release executors may perform.
Grant or refuse the complete, scoped action set required before any compound release executor starts.
Run the existing ship skill as one atomic executor through its verified change request, only after commit, push, and change-request authority are complete.
After a successful ship run, stop at the verified change request or continue to land-and-deploy according to the requested completion level.
Run the existing land-and-deploy skill as one atomic executor through merge, deployment, verification, and its bounded recovery behavior.
Record immutable decisions, transitions, evidence, authority use, and final status.
Review the run and optionally propose an improvement; on review failure emit a degraded receipt without changing the delivery status or active graph.
Close the run at the requested completion level.
Close the current attempt with an exact unresolved gate and unblocker.
Close the run after a non-recoverable failure while preserving all evidence.
